title: Ubwami aho iherezo ry'Umwami ryatagaragaraga
intro: Amateka yari azi abategetsi b'ubwoko bwose, ariko bake ni bo bategekaga intara nk'iyi. Aho umuyaga ubwawo wasubizaga itegeko ryabo n'abakozi nta jisho ry'umuntu ryashoboraga kubona bakora akazi katoroshye mu ituze, iyi ngoma yari itandukanye n'indi yabanjirije cyangwa iya nyuma. Nyamara ndetse n'ubwami bukomeye bwagombaga kurangira—kandi ubwo ubu bwarangiraga, ukuri kwavuye mu isoko ryoroheje cyane ku buryo nta muntu n'umwe wari warigeze gukeka.
clues: Umwami wanjye yampaye ubwami bunini, buvugwa mu mapaji matagatifu.
Narazwe ubwenge n'ububasha bikomeye n'umubyeyi wanbanjirije mu kwiyegurira Imana.
Nategetse umuyaga, maze ugenda kure ku bw'ibyo nashakaga.
Ibiremwa bitabonwa n'amaso asanzwe byakoreye munsi y'ububasha bwanjye, byubaka ibitangaza bitagereranywa.
Amasōko y'umuringa washongeshejwe yantembaga, umugisha udasanzwe mu batoranijwe na Allah.
Ubwo navaga kuri iyi si, umubiri wanjye wakomeje guhagarara uhagaze ku nkoni. Igihe ikiremwa gito cyo mu isi cyaryaga iyo nkoni, abari banyiri hafi ni bwo bamenye ko narashize.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
